integrity: The analytic proof is given in RESULT.md. Numerical checks are diagnostics and cannot prove the asymptotic theorem. Historical priority remains literature-bounded.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic heterogeneous SIR, positive initial infection, finite nonnegative susceptibility support with some positive mass; fixed-law large-transmission limit; not uniform near zero susceptibility; no claim of finite-population stochastic theorem or unique optimal heterogeneity.
title: Least-positive-susceptibility control of high-transmission epidemic peak time
